item.title: Runbook: billing dispute review
item.body: When a client disputes a charge, record a billing review request with the charge reference and the client's stated reason category. Explain that the review is accepted and pending; do not promise a refund, credit or outcome. The billing team owns the decision and follows up through the client's registered contact preferences.
